_doc: Retail listings for Equihash ASICs. Prices, stock and shipping are copied from the vendor product page and never invented. equihash.com has no checkout; every CTA is an outbound product URL.

listings.title: Bitmain Antminer Z15 Pro 860KSol
listings.hashrate_note: Shop states 860 kSol; Bitmain's typical published figure is 840 kSol (see Hardware).
listings.shipping_note: Free UK delivery (schema shippingRate £0 to GB). DDP UK/EU warehouse; duties and taxes included per shop copy. Handling 1–3 business days; transit 2–10 days.
listings.image_license_note: Product photo from the vendor listing page; omitted from the local build until a reviewed local asset is imported.
